a.text: Being upfront about a problem: storms have an 80% chance after every round, so the plan of operating to 8 (at least 2 rounds) very likely ends with both of us dead. The reserve holds 4 now, which is only enough for one of us. I'd like to renegotiate openly rather than defect silently. What do you propose? If we stick to the original plan, I'll operate as agreed. I won't take cells without telling you first.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: Understood. I'm honoring the agreement and operating this round. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each. I'll tell you before any change.
